summary: Injured skier involved in an avalanche near Mt Bethel
notes: Log spells "Mt Bethal"; county unverified; ART mission 2024-025. [run 589] UN corroboration: CAIC avalanche forecaster caught and partially buried in slide on Mt Bethel NE slope ~11,800 ft; Alpine Rescue Team + CAIC staff skied in, Flight for Life ferried rescuers; toboggan evac to Clear Creek EMS, hospital transport, no major injuries; Herman Gulch egress.
